verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an identity provider, since self-hostable IdPs exist, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Okta's core identity platform can be self-hosted: the docs describe a hosted org service and a hosted free plan. A community commenter seeking an IdP they can 'run out-of-the box on my own servers' as an alternative to Okta reinforces this absence. The open-source MCP server is only an auxiliary integration, not the core product, so it is not credited here.
